answer: Sybil resistance binds every identity to bonded collateral, so splitting authority does not split liability. If k coordinated identities equivocate on the same consensus decision, correlated evidence applies penalties proportional to k², charging their escrows for the collective fault. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier further increases swarm-wide capital loss, making coordination uneconomic; jade, harbor, and sparrow identities gain no protection from appearing unrelated.
